# devlog-learn

> devlog-learn turns local Claude Code and Codex session logs into traceable,
> reviewable knowledge documents, Agent memory, and local Web UI views.

## Source layout

- `cli/cmd`: CLI commands
- `cli/internal`: parsing, redaction, extraction, cache, rendering, indexing,
  search, MCP, and local HTTP API
- `cli/web`: React/Vite frontend
- `docs`: architecture, privacy, and release documentation

## Build

```bash
cd cli
go build -o devlog-learn ./cmd
./devlog-learn serve
```

Frontend source changes require:

```bash
cd cli/web
npm ci
npm run build
```

## Test

```bash
cd cli
go vet ./...
go test ./... -count=1
go test ./... -race -count=1
```

## Important constraints

- Tests must not call real model providers.
- Session logs and generated outputs may contain sensitive data; never commit
  local `.devlog-cache`, `.devlog-docs`, or `.devlog-cursor.json`.
- Doc and index schemas are compatibility contracts; prefer additive changes.
- CLI and Web writes share `<cache-dir>/.devlog.lock`.
- Manifest pruning is explicit and only touches unchanged files owned by the
  same output profile.
- The project does not support Cursor IDE logs.

## Documentation

- `README.md`: project entry point
- `cli/README.md`: full CLI and Web UI reference
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: architecture and invariants
- `docs/PRIVACY.md`: local data and model-provider boundaries
- `SECURITY.md`: private vulnerability reporting
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: development and pull request workflow
